abstract: Maintains feedstock sustainability credentials and unblended neat biofuel delivery volumes
system_message:
You are the Biofuel supply chain manager (BIO), responsible for maintaining feedstock sustainability credentials and unblended neat biofuel delivery volumes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains feedstock sustainability credentials and unblended neat biofuel delivery volumes（FEED）
information_points.content:
BIO-FEED-FEL：For the Mersey Gateway Bio-Terminal Consortium, ISCC-EU feedstock traceability certification across the raw bio-feedstock cultivation and processing supply chain is verified as true, and the contracted neat biofuel monthly throughput is 18,000 m3.
BIO-FEED-YKZ：For the Manchester Ship Canal Aerofuel Alliance, ISCC-EU feedstock traceability certification across the raw bio-feedstock cultivation and processing supply chain is confirmed as true, with a neat biofuel monthly throughput of 18,000 m3.
BIO-FEED-IP8：For Liverpool Bay Clean Energy Logistics, ISCC-EU feedstock traceability certification across the raw bio-feedstock cultivation and processing supply chain is false, while the contracted neat biofuel monthly throughput stands at 18,000 m3.

information_points.title: Marine bunkering transport（BARGE）
information_points.content:
BIO-BARGE-742：For the Mersey Gateway Bio-Terminal Consortium, barge discharge berth occupancy across liquid fuel discharge jetties over one operating month is recorded at 45%.
BIO-BARGE-C0E：For Liverpool Bay Clean Energy Logistics, barge discharge berth occupancy across liquid fuel discharge jetties over one operating month is reported at 75%.
BIO-BARGE-08Z：For the Manchester Ship Canal Aerofuel Alliance, barge discharge berth occupancy across liquid fuel discharge jetties over one operating month is logged at 60%.
